### Joy That Doesn't Need Perfect Circumstances
Author: Alisha Headley
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/joy-that-doesnt-need-perfect-circumstances.html
Passage: Habakkuk 3:18
Points:
- People often assume joy only arrives once life goes according to plan.
- Habakkuk demonstrates that true joy is anchored in God Himself, not in fluctuating outcomes.
- Deep spiritual joy is discovered when learning that God is sufficient even when circumstances are painful.
- Remembering God's past faithfulness sustains believers through current seasons of waiting and loss.
- Believers can surrender daily anxieties and rest in the unchanging character of their Savior.

### Taking Joy in the God of Salvation
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/taking-joy-god-salvation
Passage: Habakkuk 3:17-19
Points:
- True biblical faith continues to trust God's promises even when facing calamity and loss.
- Habakkuk learned to rest quietly in God's revelation rather than questioning His ways.
- Rejoicing in God for His own sake when all material support fails reflects authentic faith.
- Faith that only trusts the Lord during easy seasons is not genuine trust at all.
- God makes believers sure-footed on treacherous paths, remaining their greatest reward amid affliction.
